summary: Full-stack testing of OutreachPilot completed successfully. 14/14 backend tests passed including real LLM automation run (Emergent LLM/OpenAI gpt-5.4 generated real B2B leads and personalized cold emails). All 5 frontend flows verified: protected route redirect, login with prefilled admin creds, Command Center dashboard with stat cards + 7-day chart, Leads page with lead cards + WhatsApp buttons, Outbox with Email/WhatsApp tab switching, Automation settings save + toggle, Activity timeline, and logout. Email sending is intentionally SIMULATED (status 'sent') and WhatsApp uses wa.me click-to-send links as documented.

minor.issue: 7-day volume query uses string range on sent_at ISO field; works but is fragile if sent_at format changes across DBs
Sets access_token cookie without matching secure/samesite parity check with logout; not a bug but worth verifying rotation

issues: Admin email/password are hardcoded as default values in Login.js state (email='admin@outreachpilot.com', password='admin123'). Convenient for demo but leaks admin creds in the client bundle — remove before real launch.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Remove hardcoded admin credentials from Login.js default state before production.
OPTIONAL: Consider persisting sent_at as an ISODate (BSON) instead of ISO string for cleaner range queries in dashboard stats.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py execute_run() writes documents with `_id` set to a uuid string, then routes remap `_id`->`id` when reading — good, no ObjectId leakage.
CORSMiddleware allow_origins uses env FRONTEND_URL and allow_credentials=True — correctly configured for cookie auth.
seed_admin (startup) is idempotent and updates password if changed — good.
Backend applies max cap of 15 leads per manual run (max(1, min(count,15))) to keep LLM latency bounded — sensible.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login. Not a blocker for MVP but worth adding if this is exposed publicly.
Frontend Login.js keeps admin creds as default form state — see design_issues.
seed_data_creation: Automation test run created ~4 real leads + 4 emails via LLM as part of tests. Prior existing data (16 leads/16 emails/10 whatsapp) already present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_outreachpilot_api.py covers all endpoints and includes a real LLM run (~15-30s). Admin login is idempotent-seeded on backend startup. Frontend uses withCredentials + httpOnly cookies. Playwright viewport 1920x1080 works cleanly.
